title: benchhand rule list (<name>.rules.yaml, restricted cel-policy), provisional
description: Provisional: one rule-list file, <name>.rules.yaml (ADR-0014), written in the cel-policy format (github.com/cel-expr/cel-policy), restricted to one flat first-match match block with no aggregate, no variables and no nested rule. The first item whose condition holds gives its output; an item without a condition always holds, and the last item must be unconditional, so every list gives a value. A CI step compiles each list with the pinned cel-go policy compiler into one checked expression, and it refuses the last-item rule and the excluded features; the schema checks the rest of the shape. The file doesn't say which list it is: the reference to it in flow.yaml, or in a policy contribution, carries its kind and rules_version. The kind sets the type of every output. checks_by_iteration: a list of check ids, in run order, and [] runs none. dispatch: a handler id, or "unknown" for UNKNOWN coverage, never a pass. fidelity: the form-check fidelity, "F0" to "F3". rigor: a bool, true when the extra requirement under the project's rigor policy holds
